newsitem.title: USA: Suiza sees acquistions accretive at once.
newsitem.headline: Suiza sees acquistions accretive at once.

text.p: Suiza Foods Corp said on Tuesday it expects its two recent acquisitions, with combined annual revenues of $500 million, to be immediately accretive to earnings.

Gregg Engles, chairman and chief executive, said in a statement, "We have completed two significant dairy acquisitions. Dairy Fresh and Garelick Farms and associated companies, with combined revenues of almost $500 million in their most recent fiscal years."
Engles continued, "They (the acquisitions) are expected to be immediately accretive to earnings."
"Our team continues to pursue the ongoing consolidation of both the dairy and ice industries and we see further prospects for strategic transactions," Engles said.

The company said that it completed the acquisition of Garelick Farms and associated companies which operates three dairy processors and distributors in New England, a water bottling company in Massachusetts and 16 plastic container manufacturers in 13 states on July 31.
Suiza reported operating income for its second quarter ended June 30 of $9.0 million, or $0.55 per share, as compared to $4.6 million, or $0.46 per share, in the same period last year.

Suiza manufactures and distributes fresh milk products and refrigerated fruit drinks in Puerto Rico, fresh milk and related dairy products in Florida and packaged ice in Florida and the southwest United States.
